mapper.select: SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.project.selectProject */ PROJECT_ID as projectId, PROJECT_NAME as projectName, DESCRIPTION as description, PROJECT_IMAGE_URL as projectImageUrl, CREATED_AT as createdAt, EMAIL_SEND_TIME as emailSendTime, USER_ID as userId FROM PROJECT WHERE PROJECT_ID = #{projectId}

SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.project.selectListProject */ PROJECT_ID as projectId, PROJECT_NAME as projectName, DESCRIPTION as description, PROJECT_IMAGE_URL as projectImageUrl, CREATED_AT as createdAt, EMAIL_SEND_TIME as emailSendTime, USER_ID as userId FROM ( SELECT S.*, CEIL( (@ROWNUM:=@ROWNUM+1) / #{pageSize} ) AS PAGE FROM ( SELECT * FROM PROJECT WHERE 1=1
) S, (SELECT @ROWNUM := 0) TMP ) A WHERE PAGE = #{pageIndex}
SELECT /* QueryID : com.demo.proworks.project.selectListCountProject */ COUNT(*) totcnt FROM PROJECT WHERE 1=1
